title: Bear cub holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloonGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff7b8a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d81b3c'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='45%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c68642'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8b5a2b'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 32 C60 42 68 52 60 62' stroke='#f5e6a0' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='22' rx='14' ry='16' fill='url(#balloonGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='17' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ffb3c0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- balloon knot -->
  <polygon points='61,37 65,37 63,41' fill='#c2183a'/>
  <!-- balloon highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='16' rx='2.5' ry='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- bear body -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='72' rx='22' ry='19' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- bear belly -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='76' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#e8b87a'/>

  <!-- bear left leg -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='89' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='91' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#5c3a1a'/>

  <!-- bear right leg -->
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='89' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='91' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#5c3a1a'/>

  <!-- bear left arm (raised to hold balloon) -->
  <path d='M28 65 Q24 58 32 54 Q38 51 42 55' stroke='#a0692e' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='55' r='5' fill='#b8792e'/>

  <!-- bear right arm -->
  <path d='M60 66 Q66 70 64 78' stroke='#a0692e' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='78' r='5' fill='#b8792e'/>

  <!-- bear head -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='42' r='20' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- bear ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='26' r='8' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='26' r='4.5' fill='#e8b87a'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='26' r='8' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='26' r='4.5' fill='#e8b87a'/>

  <!-- bear muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='48' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#e8b87a'/>

  <!-- bear nose -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='45' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#3a2210'/>
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='44' rx='1.2' ry='0.8' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- bear mouth -->
  <path d='M44 47.5 Q41 51 38.5 49' stroke='#3a2210' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M44 47.5 Q47 51 49.5 49' stroke='#3a2210' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- bear eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='38' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#2a1508'/>
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='37' rx='1.2' ry='1.2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='38' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#2a1508'/>
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='37' rx='1.2' ry='1.2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='46' r='3' fill='#e8837a' opacity='0.55'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='46' r='3' fill='#e8837a' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='95' rx='26' ry='3' fill='#2a1a08' opacity='0.35'/>
</svg>
